failure.message:
Required object boundary rejects null; declare a nullable object type
S2S ownership boundary requires matching handles, a proven safe same-family upcast, or null storage initialization/assignment
Object narrowing requires a polymorphic source
Projected method receiver lifetime is deferred
S2S non-void function outlives can reach the end without returning a value
S2S data construction requires a known concrete target
S2S indexed storage requires local, parameter or field storage
S2S enum comparison requires the same enum type
S2S runtime call requires one exact signature or a unique checked-payload signature; use explicit argument types
S2S assignment requires stable storage or an indexed shared receiver
Ownership selection requires two same-family handles
